blocks.text: Psalms 53 contains 6 verses. It opens with: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity; There is none that doeth good. It concludes with: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Then shall Jacob rejoice, `and' Israel shall be glad. Psalm 54 For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. Maschil of David; when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, Doth not David hide himself with us?
